==Stats==
:[[Dark damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Blood Magic]])

:[[Energy_regeneration#Energy_regeneration_and_degeneration|Energy regeneration]] -1

This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Truncheon]] [[dye]]d white.
